text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Greenfield Retail just told me their product org is spinning up a new personalization team and expects ~3x QPS on recommendation + embedding traffic next quarter. Renewal in ~10 weeks. We should align on Dedicated pilot, enablement, and a short ROI demo for the renewal team. Any immediate blockers?
Jamal: Got it — do we have a baseline number? 3x is pretty broad. CPU/GPU qps or token/sec?
Maya: Baseline from telemetry: embeddings ~200 requests/min off our hosted cluster (spiky). They expect peaks close to 600 req/min and sustained higher throughput during daytime. For recs they want p50 <=150ms.
Priya: Renewal date is 2026-05-12. If we land a multi-team pilot we can push +$120k ARR upsell. We need a clear pilot scope and pricing option for Dedicated.
Alvin: 150ms p50 for recs — doable with an optimized model + KV caching. We'll likely want a quantized variant (int8) and prefix cache. Need sample payload sizes and avg sequence length to estimate memory/kv pressure.
Maya: I'll pull sample payloads from the account workspace and drop them into the onboarding folder. Also adding their product lead to a discovery call.
OnboardingBot: Onboarding checklist + pilot template uploaded: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/greenfield-personalization — includes pilot acceptance criteria, test dataset guidelines, and cost-estimate worksheet.
Jamal: Plan: I can run a smoke test on Dedicated staging if we get a 48h notice and their sample dataset. I'll reserve a 1x-A100-equivalent pool for the pilot week. Can we target week of Apr 5 for the smoke test?
Priya: Apr 5 works from sales side. I'll draft a short commercial proposal (pilot pricing + renewal uplift scenario) and share by EOD Thursday.
Alvin: For the smoke test I need: (1) 10-20 representative payloads, (2) expected concurrency profile (p50/p95 reqs/sec), (3) target SLOs. Also prefer to test with both FP16 and int8 builds.
Maya: Uploading payloads to the folder now and pinging the product lead. I'll capture p50/p95 from their spikes.
Priya: I'll set up an exec sponsor call for next week to align success metrics — KPI: decrease latency for recs and 2x improvement in nearest-neighbor recall with our embeddings. Without visible improvements, renewal is at risk.
Jamal: Noted. I'll add a quick runbook for failover to hosted variants if Dedicated capacity spikes.
Alvin: I'll outline quantization/latency tradeoffs in a 1-pager and drop it in the onboarding doc tomorrow.
Maya: Owners: Jamal = smoke test & capacity config; Alvin = quantization plan; Priya = pilot commercial + renewal prep; Maya = enablement + discovery. I'll sync with everyone after I finish uploading data. :+1:
Priya: Sounds good. Tag me when the executive deck is ready.
Jamal: Will do — ping me once payloads are in and I'll schedule infra.
OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled: pilot checklist review in 3 days.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll close the loop with Greenfield and post meeting notes here.
